brief.headline: Cut ₹32.69 L a year by matching our cheapest laminate price, and offer faster payment for a further discount tied to their 4.38% borrowing rate.

priceAsk.summary: Close the ₹32.69 L annual gap by matching the ₹290.00/KG we already pay Shrinath Roto Pack for the same type of laminates.
priceAsk.target: ₹290.00/KG for the top three items (currently ₹294.03, ₹308.30, ₹294.57), saving ₹32.69 L per year
priceAsk.basis: We're already paying ₹290.00/KG to Shrinath Roto Pack for similar laminates. The market asking price band is ₹205–305/kg (verdict: MARKET-FAIR top of fair band), so ₹290.00/KG is defensible and still in the fair zone. GEEP's top-three SKUs are 1.4%, 6.3%, and 1.6% above that line—bring them down.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Offer to pay in 15 days instead of 30 in exchange for a price cut of about 4.38% (their borrowing rate). If they agree, move to immediate 15-day terms; if they balk, negotiate a smaller cut but still tighten to 15 days.
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: Switching everyone to 15-day terms frees up ₹1.16 Cr of our cash (which we hold 15 days less), but paying them 15 days sooner is worth roughly 4.38% to them because that's what they pay to borrow money—so we trade cash for a price drop.

brief.financialLeverage: GEEP sells ₹291.36 Cr a year and keeps only 1.1% as profit, so there's almost no fat—push hard on price and you risk breaking supply. But their cash is stuck for 81 days, much longer than similar firms (46 days), which means they're hungry for faster payment. We're 9.72% of their total sales (₹28.31 Cr), so we're a big customer and they'll listen. Their rating is CRISIL BB+ / Stable, but the rating agency says they stopped cooperating, so treat their health as uncertain—line up a backup before you squeeze. They borrow at rates between 1.55% and 9.25% (effective 4.38%), so early payment is real money to them.

evidence.point: We pay ₹32.69 L more per year than our cheapest laminate supplier
Our best laminate price is ₹290.00/KG from Shrinath Roto Pack; GEEP charges ₹294.03, ₹308.30, ₹294.57 on top SKUs
Market asking price for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg (typical ₹250/kg), verdict MARKET-FAIR top of fair band
Their cash is stuck for 81 days vs 46 days at similar firms—so cash is tight for them
We're 9.72% of their revenue—our ₹28.31 Cr is big leverage against their ₹291.36 Cr sales
They keep 1.1% of every ₹100 they sell as profit—very thin, so a price war could hurt supply

alternates.name: Huhtamaki India Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexible-packaging converter already supplying FDC in small volumes—proven and scalable for laminate sachets (₹2755.75 Cr revenue, health C 58/100). Qualify as second source to reduce GEEP concentration (we're 76% dependent on them).

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed giant (₹17547.92 Cr revenue, health C 48/100) that makes both film and converts it—can match GEEP's laminate volumes and give us negotiating muscle.

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd (a lead to qualify—verify before RFQ)
alternates.why: Part of global Constantia group, focuses on pharma blister and sachet laminates (₹222.04 Cr revenue, health D 31/100). Strong technical fit but verify capability and price before using as leverage.

risks: GEEP is 76% of our Laminates spend (₹28.31 Cr)—we have almost no backup, so don't push so hard they walk or fail. Qualify Huhtamaki or UFLEX first.
Their rating is CRISIL BB+ / Stable but marked 'issuer not cooperating'—the agency couldn't get fresh data, so their real financial position is murky. Keep a backup ready in case they stumble.
They show GST filing delays, EPF payment delays, and pending legal cases—signs of stress. If you squeeze price too hard on a 1.1% margin, they may cut corners on quality or delivery.
Paying 15 days faster costs us ₹1.16 Cr in working cash—make sure the price cut you win (ideally around 4.38%) is worth tying up that money.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're paying ₹32.69 lakh more a year than our best laminate price—let's close that gap and talk about how faster payment can work for both of us.
